include_directories(${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/ntoskrnl/include)

# The usbuhci .c bodies (roothub/usbuhci) are replaced by Rust (usbuhci-rust,
# libusbuhci_rust.a). The .c files are kept on disk per the never-delete rule. guid.c stays
# compiled as a data-only TU (DEFINE_GUID). Bar: link-clean x3 (NOT boot-loaded in smoke).

# usbuhci.sys is all Rust (usbuhci-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/usbuhci-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(usbuhci_res OBJECT usbuhci.rc)
target_include_directories(usbuhci_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
target_compile_definitions(usbuhci_res
    # HACK: Disabled until USB Stack is reinvestigated.
    PRIVATE NO_KERNEL_LIST_ENTRY_CHECKS)
add_library(usbuhci_shims OBJECT guid.c)
target_link_libraries(usbuhci_shims PRIVATE libusbport libusbd libhal libntoskrnl)
target_compile_definitions(usbuhci_shims
    # HACK: Disabled until USB Stack is reinvestigated.
    PRIVATE NO_KERNEL_LIST_ENTRY_CHECKS)
add_cargo_module(usbuhci usbuhci-cargo usbuhci.sys
    KIND kernelmodedriver
    BODY_CRATE usbuhci-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32/drivers
    NO_CAB
    EXTRA_DEPENDS usbuhci_shims usbuhci_res psdk)
